meta.title: Key Cities under Admin-N
meta.grain: one row per NAMED location cluster, with its sub-country admin unit
meta.derivation: key_tier is a band over PIN DENSITY computed from this corpus: key-high >= 4 groups (top decile), key >= 3 (top quartile), else candidate.
meta.verification_limit: Place names are single-source: Nominatim/OSM, not cross-checked against a second gazetteer. verification_tier says exactly what was established.
meta.admin_n_note: admin_n is the sub-country unit OSM reports (276 of 277 named places have one, 81 distinct values). What that level is CALLED varies by country — geoBoundaries boundaryCanonical gives the native term (State/Union Territory, Province, Wilayat, Region...). Not mislabelled "province" for everyone.
meta.rendering: No city polygons are shipped; every row renders as a STAR pin, visually distinct from people-group pins.
meta.source: Nominatim/OpenStreetMap (ODbL 1.0) for names; people-group counts from the DX spine.
